Package neqsim.process.equipment.network

Class FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.network.FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, ProcessEquipmentInterface, ProcessElementInterface, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface, LegacyLoadRepairable
public final class FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit extends ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
Process-system adapter for one live FieldWellNetworkCoupler.

The adapter owns no additional graph or pressure-flow calculation. Its run(UUID) method executes the bound live wells against the canonical LoopedPipeNetwork, exposes the network's stable sink streams to downstream separators and compressors, and reports the process unit unsolved unless the complete coupled result is converged and finite. ProcessAutomation exposes the wrapped network's existing source, choke, route-availability, regulator, compressor and pump addresses through this unit name.

Version:
1.0
Author:

    • registerExclusiveRouteSelector

      public FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit registerExclusiveRouteSelector(String selectorName, List<String> edgeNames, String provenance)
      Register one discrete, mutually exclusive route selector over existing network edges.

      Exactly one declared edge must currently have availability 1.0; every other declared edge must have availability 0.0. The selector only changes those existing edge availabilities. It does not create a second topology or alter any hydraulic model.

      Parameters:
      selectorName - stable selector identity used by process automation
      edgeNames - existing alternative route edges in selection order
      provenance - engineering source for the mutually exclusive line-up
      Returns:
      this process unit for chaining

    • registerRouteConfigurationSelector

      public FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit registerRouteConfigurationSelector(String selectorName, List<FieldWellNetworkProcessUnit.RouteConfiguration> configurations, String provenance)
      Register named, discrete multi-edge route configurations over the existing canonical network.

      A configuration may represent a direct path, brownfield reroute, daisy-chain line-up, or redundant loop by listing every controlled edge that must have availability 1.0. Every other edge appearing in any option is set to 0.0. Registration requires the current edge state to match exactly one option and rejects overlap with another selector. The selector owns no topology or hydraulic model.

      Parameters:
      selectorName - stable selector identity used by process automation
      configurations - at least two distinct named edge line-ups in selection order
      provenance - engineering source for the route line-ups
      Returns:
      this process unit for chaining

    • setExclusiveRouteSelection

      public void setExclusiveRouteSelection(String selectorName, double selectedRoute)
      Atomically select one existing route and make every alternative unavailable.

      The candidate must be an exact zero-based integer route index. All affected edge availabilities are captured before mutation, written as an exact one-hot line-up, and verified. Any write/read-back failure restores every captured availability before the exception is propagated. A successful change marks this process unit unsolved; the surrounding process model must rerun the live well/network coupling before using the candidate.

      Parameters:
      selectorName - registered selector identity
      selectedRoute - zero-based route index
